description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) called SubunitCountPair, which encapsulates a Subunit entity and an associated integer count, likely used to represent a pair of subunit and count information within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin.

classes.name: SubunitCountPair
classes.description: A DTO class that holds a Subunit object and an integer count, with constructor and getter methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Subunit and count properties.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the Subunit object stored in this pair.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the count associated with the subunit.
